answer.summary: A snug Nordic winter town of eleven buildings, laid out around a central festival square with a decorated spruce. It has a great festival hall, four homes, a bakery, a toymaker's workshop, a chapel of lights on higher ground, a sleigh stable at the edge, and an ice rink. The style bible is made after this plan, and nothing in it is waiting on unsupported features.
